summary: Executed final pre-cutover migration acceptance checks on local OpenNext preview (http://127.0.0.1:8787) plus live backend via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Contact RFQ real submission, compare carry-over, analytics taxonomy/PII checks, mobile usability, route contracts, and failure states were validated. One critical gate failed: raw /contact HTML did not contain a literal <h1> in source response.

critical.issue: Raw HTML source did not contain a literal <h1> tag (pytest assertion count=0) despite hydrated UI showing one H1.

action_items: Fix SSR/raw HTML output contract for /contact so source includes literal semantic H1 content in HTML response.
Keep remote Cloudflare gate explicitly BLOCKED until scoped credentials + wrangler are available in environment.
After SSR fix, rerun iteration145 pytest + contact raw HTML checks to confirm acceptance gate passes.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact page is marked force-dynamic and includes client-heavy rendering; current raw HTML response appears flight/script driven and misses literal semantic heading content required by gate.
No MOCKED API usage detected in tested RFQ/analytics flows; /api/leads and /api/track used real backend endpoints.
Several Next components remain one-line minified JSX, increasing review/debug risk for future migration gates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated real lead submissions from /contact?products=BL-COB125,BL-OH6,BL-TX2 with captured payload source=comparison_request and product_interest='BL-COB125, BL-OH6, BL-TX2' and backend 200. Invalid phone produced backend 422 and visible error status. Simulated network failure by aborting /api/leads produced visible 'Failed to fetch' error (no fake success). Compare flow selected 3 real codes, pricing CTA carried exact codes to contact context. Analytics /api/track capture confirmed page_view, filter/search/finder, product_view, compare add/remove/view, comparison_pricing_request, RFQ_started/contact_submission/RFQ_completed; no email/phone/name/message keys in analytics payloads. Focused navigation check showed no double initial page_view and one page_view each for compare/back/forward transitions. Route checks passed for /products, /products/bl-cob125, /compare, /contact, /dubai, /solutions, /case-studies, /resources, /our-works(308), /products/hjdba(410), sitemap/robots/llms, unknown 404.
rca of the issue: RCA for failed gate: raw HTML contract failure on /contact. Repro: GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/contact and inspect response source; canonical is present but literal <h1> is absent (pytest failure), while browser DOM after hydration shows one H1. Likely due server response composition relying on flight/script payload for render output under current dynamic rendering path. Mitigation: ensure SSR output for /contact includes semantic heading markup directly in HTML source before hydration.
